$comment: Lead-owned (contract V2-1.11 §5.7). humanMax/pendingMax may only be lowered; raising either, or adding a humanDecisions reason, is a lead change citing a decision id.

humanMaxRaised.why: S5.3 registers the AI run registry's row actions (V2-1.15 §5.10): Keep going and Cancel the waiting prompt are human 'ai-chat' by Q5 (the same reason S5.7 adds); AI runs and Stop are human until S5.4 builds `maude design runs list|stop`, which turns them cli and lowers this by 2. Four human rows.

S5.7 registers the AI chat list's row commands (New chat, Rename…, Archive, Move to trash, Copy transcript: human 'ai-chat', the conversation is the person's to drive) and Open in terminal (human 'native-window', a Tauri command that spawns Terminal). Six human rows.

S1.2: Pin canvas, Unpin canvas, Sort canvases and Copy canvas link are per-person view state (pins are the person's, the sort order is a per-project view preference, the link goes to the clipboard) — human (view-pref) by design, the same reason as view.pin-panels and edit.copy-properties. Four human rows.

S3.2b: tool.pointer (L, Present's one tool) is the presenter's mouse made visible to the audience; an agent has no pointer to show and no equivalent of one, so it is human 'keys' by design. present.next / present.prev are NAV (`maude design open <canvas>#<artboard> --mode present`), not human. One human row.

S5.12: the AI chat's Advanced fold (Model, Effort, Fast mode, Ask before, Show in chat, Suggestions, Raw log) is seven chat.advanced.* registry actions so ⌘K finds them as "AI chat panel › Advanced"; they tune the person's own conversation, human 'ai-chat' like S5.7's rows. Seven human rows.

S2.6: object.select-matching (same style) is a selection in the person's window, with no route and no edit-op; an agent greps the canvas for the same className and style. Human 'view-pref'. One human row.

S1.7b registers trash.clear (the Trash's Clear out…): deleting for good what the team could still restore is the project owner's own confirmation, never an agent's — human 'clear-trash'. One human row. trash.restore gets its agent path with S1.17's `maude design trash restore` and is not registered yet.

S5.10 registers the paperclip's four ways in (ai.attach-files, ai.attach-folder, ai.attach-assets, ai.attach-screenshot): attaching is how a PERSON hands the AI a file or a folder, and a folder grant is consent only the person can give; an agent reads files itself. Human 'ai-chat'. Four human rows.

S3.6b registers present.presenter-view (Presenter view on another display): a window-level preference only a person's click sets, on a second display an agent has no window on — human 'native-window'. One human row.

S2.10: artboard.ask-ai is the artboard menu's Ask AI row (⌘/), a request the person makes of the AI chat; an agent has nobody to ask. Human 'ai-chat' like every chat row. The row is greyed until S5's composer takes the artboard.

humanMaxRaisedNote: V2-5 A1 integration: the three slice raises stack on 86 (84 -> 86 by decision:maude/v2-4-gate-github-doors, human 'accounts'). S4.1/S4.3/S4.4 and S2.2-S2.4 add no human row. 86 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 100 human actions in the merged registry. V2-5 A2 integration: S5.4 builds `maude design runs list|stop`, so ai.runs.list and ai.stop turn cli (decision:maude/v2-S5.3-run-actions-human-until-s5.4 resolved by decision:maude/v2-S5.4-runs-fallback-prompts) and the cap lowers 100 -> 98; S3.1, S4.2, S4.5, S9.4, S2.5 and S1.4 add no human row. V2-5 A4 integration: measured 107 human actions in the merged registry (98 on feat + tool.pointer from S3.2b + 7 chat.advanced.* from S5.12 + object.select-matching from S2.6); every other A4 slice adds no human row. V2-5 A5 integration: measured 113 human actions in the merged registry (107 on feat + trash.clear from S1.7b + four ai.attach-* from S5.10 + present.presenter-view from S3.6b); every other A5 slice adds no human row. S9.24 base (s2-10 on A5): artboard.ask-ai (decision:maude/v2-S2.10-ask-ai-row-human) is the 114th.
